sloka: प्रति उज्जगाम संहृष्टो ब्रह्माणम् इव वासवः ।तम् दृष्ट्वा ज्वलितम् दीप्त्या तपसम् संशित व्रतम् ॥१-१८-४३॥
transliteration: prati ujjagāma saṁhṛṣṭo brahmāṇam iva vāsavaḥ ।tam dṛṣṭvā jvalitam dīptyā tapasam saṁśita vratam ॥1-18-43॥

translations.english: Viswamitra received the offerings as ordained in the scriptures and enquired from the king about the welfare and prosperity of his kingdom.
